methodology.cuda_event_scope: average per invocation, includes GPU stream gaps from host dispatch; not isolated profiler kernel duration
methodology.host_scope: one invocation with synchronization before/after; includes Python and synchronization overhead
methodology.first_use: first invocation in this process; may use existing Triton/Inductor disk caches; not guaranteed cold compile
methodology.memory: warmed allocator peaks, resident inputs and custom arena included; driver, external allocations and compiler CPU memory excluded
methodology.ordering: implementation order rotated by case; cases grouped by dtype and shape; laptop clocks, thermals and background activity remain confounders
methodology.inductor: fullgraph=True, dynamic=False, default mode; no suppression or eager fallback; compiler in-memory state reset per case
